geographies: central northern Bulgaria to the Pre-Balkans
evidence.compact_statement: Source dated 2024-12-31 reports: 1981–2010 drought mapping identifies the Danube corridor and central north to the Pre-Balkans; Northeast Bulgaria/Dobrudzha is most affected, with pockets around Blagoevgrad, Petrich–Sandanski and Mesta valley.
recommendations: No wording change is indicated by the record-only check; keep the claim provisional until its cited passage is independently reopened.

geographies: Struma River valley near Kresna Gorge
evidence.compact_statement: Source dated 2024-12-31 reports: Struma valley near Kresna Gorge is hottest: some years had 6–8 days above 40°C; 1961–2020 records show 40–55 hot days/year there versus 2–3 on the northern Black Sea coast.
recommendations: No wording change is indicated by the record-only check; keep the claim provisional until its cited passage is independently reopened.

evidence.compact_statement: Source dated 2021-03 reports: For the June 2014 torrential-rain flash flood in Asparuhovo (Varna), the WB box reports 122 evacuated families, Roma ownership of 60% of destroyed houses, and 14 deaths, most among Roma.
recommendations: No wording change is indicated by the record-only check; keep the claim provisional until its cited passage is independently reopened.

evidence.compact_statement: Source dated 2021-03 reports: The report links unequal flood losses in Asparuhovo to informal Roma housing that failed building-code/zoning standards and to inadequate municipal prevention; it says no clear data show how many Roma live in flood-prone areas.
recommendations: No wording change is indicated by the record-only check; keep the claim provisional until its cited passage is independently reopened.
